lineage: Chinese analogue of MMLU (2020-09); sibling of C-Eval (2023-05); same group released ACLUE (ancient Chinese). No official successor version.
best_by_cutoff: 91.9 (Qwen2.5-Max base, 5-shot, 2025-01-28, https://qwenlm.github.io/blog/qwen2.5-max/ ; value is in a chart image, taken from the lab-report input, not re-verified textually). score_at_release_system: GPT-5 (high), no tools (arXiv v1 / GitHub README); 10.6 with code, 12.6 with code & web
lineage: CritPt v1 (2025-09; on Artificial Analysis 2025-11-21) -> Anthropic internal 'CritPT-Corrected' (2026-09-01) -> independent audit/corrected 54-challenge subset (arXiv 2609.13009, 2026-09-11); Artificial Analysis marks CritPt 'Under review' pending the authors' revised dataset.

E(iii) judgement call: independent audit found >=20% defective items (37.5% of audited challenges per secondary summary; exact count not confirmed in the paper text I could fetch), and Anthropic publicly stopped reporting the original CritPt in favour of its own corrected edition - but Anthropic's switch (2026-09-01) PRECEDED the independent audit (2026-09-11) by 10 days, so the 'after which' ordering holds only at month precision / if Anthropic's own correction counts as the audit. If E is rejected, status would be 'alive' (lab reports through 2026-09-01; AA leaderboard active). canonical_name: FActScore: Fine-grained Atomic Evaluation of Factual Precision in Long Form Text Generation (biography generation)
metric: FActScore = % of atomic facts in generated biographies supported by the knowledge source; labs report claim-level hallucination/error rate (lower is better) -> converted as 100 - error rate
direction: higher (after conversion of lab-reported error rates)
ab_score: ~96-97 (=100 minus claim-level error 2.8% per blog appendix lab report / 3.7% per system-card browsing-disabled figure)
ab_mode: no tools; claim-level error rate graded by OpenAI o3 with browsing (OpenAI implementation, not the original Wikipedia+ChatGPT/Inst-LLaMA estimator)
ab_source: https://cdn.openai.com/gpt-5-system-card.pdf (2025-08-07; 'we report claim-level error rates'; grader = OpenAI o3 listing claims and fact-checking with browsing; browsing-disabled figure: gpt-5-thinking 3.7%, gpt-5-main ~5.6-7.8%, o3 24.2%, GPT-4o 37.7%); blog https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-5/ appendix 'FActScore hallucination rate (no tools)' 2.8% (from lab-report input, not visible to fetch tool)
score_at_release_system: PerplexityAI (human-annotated FActScore, 183 labeled entities; best LM without retrieval: ChatGPT 58.3, InstructGPT 42.5)
lineage: FActScore (2023-05; EMNLP 2023) -> successors/alternatives by others: LongFact/SAFE (2024-03), VeriScore (2024-06); OpenAI/xAI use re-implemented graders on the FActScore bio prompts (2025).
best_by_cutoff: 99.1 (gpt-5-thinking with browsing, 0.9% claim-level error, GPT-5 system card 2025-08; tool-assisted); no-tools ~96-97 (GPT-5, 2025-08); Grok 4.1 ~97.0 (2.97% error rate, 2025-11-17, per lab-report input/secondary).
notes: No official leaderboard; no human baseline -> B (90). Lab results are error rates (lower is better) converted to 100-error. Standard-metric caveat: the original estimator (retrieval over 2023 Wikipedia + ChatGPT or Inst-LLaMA+NP, gamma=10 length penalty) is not what OpenAI/xAI use (OpenAI: o3 grader with browsing, claim-level); I treat these as implementations of the same construct. GPT-4o in OpenAI's grading = 37.7% error (62.3), consistent with ~60s FActScores for GPT-4/ChatGPT in the 2023 paper. No pre-2025-08 >=90 result on the official entity set was found (search limited; factuality-alignment papers on small models report far lower), but earlier third-party >=90 claims cannot be ruled out. Possible propensity reading (abstention/hallucination behaviour) noted; kept main as factual-precision capability. No independent >=90 run found -> strict blank. Fetch-tool readings of the system-card figures were inconsistent between calls (gpt-5-main 5.6% vs 7.8%), so AB score given as a range; all GPT-5-thinking values are well above 90 while o3 without browsing (24.2% error -> 75.8) is below, so 2025-08 is the first lab >=90 in no-tools mode.
